info.name: Bookly API
info.description:
Accounts & auth for Bookly (Express + MongoDB + JWT).

Run **Sign up** (or **Sign in**) first: the test scripts store `accessToken`, `refreshToken` and `userId` in collection variables, and every authenticated request uses `{{accessToken}}` as its Bearer token.

Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:4000). Sign up uses a random email each run so the folder can be run top to bottom with the Collection Runner.

Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "field" } }`.

request.description: Creates an email/password account. `profileComplete` is false until a username is set with **Update profile**.

exec: pm.test('new account has no username yet', () => pm.expect(json.user.profileComplete).to.eql(false));
// Fresh email + username each run so the Collection Runner can repeat the flow.

request.description: Rotates the refresh token: the old one stops working. Reusing an old one signs the user out everywhere.
Revokes the stored refresh token. The access token stays valid until it expires (15 min), which is why the next request can still call Sign out everywhere.
Revokes every refresh token and invalidates all access tokens (the next request with the old access token gets 401). **Sign in again** follows so the rest of the collection keeps working.
Body: { idToken } from Google Sign-In. Verified against GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS; 201 for a new account, 200 otherwise.

exec: // A real idToken comes from Google Sign-In in the app/website; a fake one is rejected.

request.description: Always 202. Emails a reset link (or logs it when RESEND_API_KEY isn't set).

item.name: Posts
item.description: Feed, posts, votes and shelves. Runs after Auth (needs accessToken + userId).

request.description: Body → form-data → key `cover` (File). Returns { url } to send as coverUri. Needs CLOUDINARY_* on the server.
Fields are optional: send only what changed. `avatarUri` takes a URL or null.
Body → form-data → key `avatar` (type File) → choose a photo. Needs CLOUDINARY_* in .env (otherwise 503 uploads_not_configured).
Signed params for uploading a book cover straight to Cloudinary: POST `file` + every entry of `fields` as form-data to `uploadUrl`.

exec: pm.test('has signed fields', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.uploadUrl).to.include('api.cloudinary.com'); pm.expect(b.fields.signature).to.be.a('string'); });
